data.description: "A new approach to uderstanding the ever-changing information that bombards us. Arbesman is an expert in scientometrics, literally the science of science--how we know what we know. It turns out that knowledge in most fields evolves in systematic and predictable ways, and understanding that evolution can enormously powerful"--
data.title: The Half-Life of Facts
data.subtitle: Why Everything We Know Has an Expiration Date
